display_name: P3 benchmark-native validity and explicit preprocessing boundary

policies.structural_gate: exact canonical model-view columns, readable serialization, safe base-type conversion, and exact requested synthetic row count
policies.column_validity: all reviewed hard rules are intersected per cell and canonical columns receive equal weight
policies.constraint_validity: reviewed applicable cross-column constraints receive equal weight; no reviewed applicable constraint yields not_applicable
policies.validity_aggregation: 0.5 column plus 0.5 constraint when the constraint component computes; otherwise column validity only
policies.fully_valid_row_rate: reported separately and excluded from aggregation because it is width-sensitive
policies.preprocessing: missing-value state is fitted on real train only; policy and transformed schema are versioned and checksummed
policies.synthetic_repair: prohibited; original decoded output is immutable and scored as observed
policies.finalization: Atomic Results, rule details, provenance, stages, inventory, and exact checksums must validate before final status publication

change_log.change: Implemented deterministic reviewed validity rules and the explicit train-only preprocessing boundary.
